layman_headline: Fear grips the crypto market — no quality setups worth chasing right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a fearful mood, with Bitcoin sliding below $63,000 and most altcoins bleeding. The swing trade candidates today are either wildly overbought after 100%+ runs (AKE, VELVET), stablecoins with no trading opportunity (FDUSD, RLUSD), or lacking enough technical data to build a confident trade. UNI dropped 20% in a week which could be a bounce play, but with high BTC dominance crushing altcoins and bearish headlines piling up, catching that falling knife is risky. Solana is the strongest large-cap alt, holding relatively steady, but doesn't have a clear entry trigger yet.
layman_action: Stay in cash and wait. The market is weak and fearful — this is the time to build a watchlist, not force trades. If Solana dips toward $72-73, it could offer a solid entry with defined risk.
expert_reasoning: The market environment is hostile to new long entries: Fear & Greed at 29 and worsening, BTC dominance at 56.1% crushing altcoin relative performance, and BTC itself breaking below $63K with ETF outflows. The swing candidates are poor quality — AKE at RSI 79 after a 170% run is a textbook short, not a buy. VELVET lacks RSI/MACD data after a 118% run. UNI's -20% drop is tempting as a mean-reversion play but the macro backdrop (high BTC dominance, fear sentiment, bearish news flow) makes catching falling knives dangerous. SOL shows relative strength but no clear technical trigger. Discipline dictates waiting for either a broader fear capitulation event or a specific coin to set up with confirmed technical signals.
risk_factors: BTC could break below $62K support, triggering a broader market cascade that drags all alts down further
U.S.-Iran geopolitical tensions and rising yields could drive a risk-off move across all crypto
SEC regulatory uncertainty (cancelled meeting) could weigh on sentiment for weeks
watch_list: BTC price action around $62,000 support — a breakdown here changes the entire market calculus
SOL behavior if it pulls back to $72-73 range — could set up a defined-risk swing entry
UNI stabilization — if it holds $3.00 and RSI reaches oversold territory, it becomes a stronger bounce candidate
market_context: Crypto is in a fear-driven pullback with BTC dominance rising and altcoins underperforming. Headlines are bearish across the board — ETF outflows, geopolitical risk, regulatory cancellations — and no clear catalyst for reversal is visible yet.
context_banner: Market in fear mode with no high-conviction setups — capital preservation is the priority until conditions improve.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 29 with worsening trend signals broad risk aversion — not ideal for new long entries, though historically contrarian at extremes.
Multiple bearish headlines: BTC below $63K, ETF drawdowns, cluster of headwinds including rising yields and geopolitical risks.
AKE's RSI at 79 after 170% weekly gain confirms overbought exhaustion — our most reliable signal source says avoid this.
Bitcoin facing potential Binance long liquidation cascade ('cleanout') — adds downside risk to any new positions.
No volume breakout signals present on any quality candidates — reinforces the HOLD decision.
